pathways.title: Experienced Tradeswomen
pathways.text: Carpenters, generalists, journeypersons and trade-business owners who want to do great work on a crew that has their back.

pathways.title: Construction Managers
pathways.text: People who can plan, price and run projects with clear scope, budget and accountability.

pathways.title: Site Supervisors & Forewomen
pathways.text: Leaders who keep sites safe, organized and moving, and who teach as they go.

pathways.title: Apprentices
pathways.text: Women working toward a trade who want real experience, support and progression.

pathways.title: Career Changers
pathways.text: Women coming from other fields who are ready to learn and bring strong transferable skills.

pathways.title: Office & Operations Professionals
pathways.text: Estimating, scheduling, purchasing, finance and admin: the systems that support the field.

pathways.title: Mentors & Trainers
pathways.text: Experienced women who want to pass on what they know through the Academy.

pathways.title: Professional Partners
pathways.text: Women-owned trades, designers, engineers and professionals who want to collaborate on projects.
